method: category- and faction-aware composition of reviewed explosion, debris, impact, smoke and fire raster families

variants.air: blast, outward debris and trailing smoke
variants.ground: blast, debris, short wreck fire and smoke
variants.sea: water displacement beneath blast, debris and superstructure smoke
variants.autonomous: cold debris tint plus broken EMP field collapse
variants.infantry: subdued dust/scatter consequence with no wreck fire

visual_contract.purpose: make destruction communicate material, scale and category rather than replaying one universal flash
reject: single generic explosion for every target
